verdict.rationale: Penpot explicitly documents self-hosting via docker compose, Kubernetes/Helm, or any private/on-prem environment, claims a 3-minute setup, and emphasizes data privacy and control (penpot-docs-7,8,17,26,28,30,34). A runtime probe confirms the official docker-compose stack actually boots a full working self-hosted instance (penpot-probe-rt-1), and community users independently report successfully self-hosting on Docker for weeks (penpot-comm-9,12), though a few report stability/performance issues at scale (penpot-comm-10,11) which affects robustness rather than the core capability. Missing for 10: independent large-scale production self-hosting case studies free of stability complaints.
